QuestInfo.name: Diamonds for the Queen
QuestInfo.0: #p9074200# is happy with the silk. But maybe it's still not enough?
QuestInfo.1: #p9074200# thinks a queen should have some diamonds to go along with her silk, but the only place to get one is from #p9074203#, the Suspicious Merchant. Go to the Oasis and see if he has a rock to sell.

0.0: This fabric looks wonderful! But is it good enough for a queen? No! She needs gold and jewels and gold-coated jewels! You know I'm right!

yes.0: Shiny Diamonds are perfect for a beautiful queen like #p9074201#! Too bad this shabby desert is covered in Lidium...
yes.1: The only way to get a diamond way out here is through that no good merchant,  #p9074203#. He'll be lurking around the oasis, I assure you...

item.0: Go deal with that rascal, #p9074203#, and get me my diamond!
